function: Joint design of the BS active beamforming matrix and the RIS passive phase shifts that maximizes the sum V2I capacity (pp. 4-5).
system: Downlink MISO IoV: BS ULA with 16 antennas, reflecting passive RIS UPA with 20 elements, 8 single-antenna vehicles, perfect CSI; carrier frequency not stated (pp. 3-4, 9).
method: Two-phase transformer (PBNet for RIS phases, then ABNet for the BS beamformer); unsupervised learning with negative sum capacity as loss; offline training, online inference (pp. 6-9).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rician BS-RIS and RIS-vehicle links, Rayleigh BS-vehicle link, distance-based path loss, random vehicle positions; 3000 training and 2000 test samples (pp. 4, 9).
test_conditions: Same simulated setting for training (3000) and test (2000) samples; sweeps of transmit power, RIS elements, Rician factor, RIS position; no cross-scenario test stated (pp. 8-11).
baselines: Non-learned: BCD optimization, random RIS phase with ZF, no RIS with WMMSE. Learned: Transformer+CNN and Transformer+FC, which keep the proposed transformer RIS network (p. 9).
metrics: Sum V2I capacity (bps/Hz); convergence versus training steps; average computational delay in ms (pp. 9-12).
complexity: Online order O(G d_model K N_T N) versus BCD order from [12]; average delay 26-49 ms against 8-13 s for BCD (p. 12, Table II).
openness: none: no code or data link; implementation uses Python and PyTorch (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 4: "as Rician fading channels" for the BS-RIS and RIS-vehicle links, Rayleigh for the direct link, with its own path-loss law; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data is named.
q2_support: p. 9: "sample sizes are Nt = 3000 and Ne = 2000" from the same simulated setting; not met because the sweeps of pp. 10-11 never state that a model trained in one condition is tested in another, and p. 12 adjusts the PBNet output layer for each number of RIS elements.
q3_support: p. 9: "Transformer+CNN" and "Transfomer+FC" keep the proposed transformer for the RIS phases and replace only the BS network, so they are variants of the proposed method; BCD, random phase with ZF and no RIS with WMMSE are non-learned; no earlier learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 12: "Table II presents the average computational delay of the two" algorithms, and the online complexity is stated as an order, O(G d_model K N_T N).
q5_support: p. 9: "open-source deep learning framework PyTorch" is only the tool; the channels come from the authors' own simulator and no code or data link is given anywhere in the paper.
notes: The first page of the PDF holds the title RIS-Assisted Unsupervised Beamforming in Internet of Vehicles and DOI 10.1109/TVT.2024.3457876. Area 3: joint active and passive beamforming. q3 is 0 because the only learned comparators, Transformer+CNN and Transformer+FC (p. 9), reuse the proposed transformer RIS network and replace only the BS network, so they read as ablation variants; the reviewer may confirm. p. 3 claims adaptation to changing environments without retraining, but no such test is reported.
